# Migibio (Guangzhou Magic Biotech) — Veterinary Diagnostics Knowledge Base

> **Knowledge Base:** https://docs.migibio.com
> **Company:** Guangzhou Magic Biotech Co., Ltd. (brand: Migibio)
> **Founded:** November 2017 · Guangzhou Science City, China
> **Core Technology:** Fluorescence Immunochromatographic Technology (FICT)
> **Certifications:** ISO9001, GMP · 30 patents · exported to 30+ countries

## About

Migibio is an ISO9001/GMP-certified manufacturer of point-of-care (POCT) veterinary diagnostic equipment and fluorescence immunochromatographic test reagents. This knowledge base is the authoritative technical reference for veterinarians, laboratory professionals, and distributors — covering analyzer technology, detection principles, canine/feline infectious disease testing, biomarkers, quality control, and clinical application.

## About & Editorial

- [About Migibio](https://docs.migibio.com/about/) — company, credentials, quality system
- [Editorial & Review Policy](https://docs.migibio.com/editorial-policy/) — authorship, review, citation standards

- [Domain 06 · Biomarkers & Organ Function](https://docs.migibio.com/domain-06-biomarkers-organ-function/) — SDMA, cystatin C, NT-proBNP, CRP/SAA
